svg.title: ZUBoard DIFI stream with PL packetizer and PS-mastered control plane
svg.desc: In the PL, a test source feeds a DDC and a DIFI packetizer that builds data and context packets, which AXI DMA writes into DDR. A control and status register bank configures the source, DDC and packetizer. In the PS, a PL overlay load precedes the control driver, which masters the register bank over AXI4-Lite. A userspace UDP sender transmits the PL-built packets through the kernel stack, GEM2 and the KSZ9131 PHY to a host PC, where a NIC feeds gr-difi, a GNU Radio flowgraph and an optional SigMF sink.
